card.name: Dose after "lowest effective"
card.fires_on: The word dose, dosage or doses right after "the lowest effective" in label advice about using the smallest amount for the shortest time.

modes.label: NSAID dose advice
modes.description: "Use the lowest effective dose" followed by "for the shortest duration" in anti-inflammatory drug warnings.
modes.example: Use the lowest effective<< dose>> for the shortest duration consistent with individual patient

modes.label: Dosage in controlled-drug or estrogen text
modes.description: "Prescribe the lowest effective dosage" or "prescribed at the lowest effective doses" in benzodiazepine or hormone labels.
modes.example: Prescribe the lowest effective<< dosage>>; avoid or minimize concomitant use

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about time or duration, as in "for the shortest time", after the dose word.
card.plain: It marks the word dose in the phrase "lowest effective dose", which is usually followed by a mention of how long to use the drug.
